transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because I just can't seem to keep my mind on one thing anymore. 

At work, if... if a saw starts up, or somebody walks past the office, I just get pulled off what I'm doing. Even just thinking about another job does it. And then... I don't know, the whole day just gets away from me.
Did you have this same kind of trouble focusing when you were a child?

Yeah... I suppose I did. Um. Even back in grade school... before I was 12, I think... teachers were always telling my mother I was bright, but careless. I was always losing my homework. Or forgetting instructions. I'd just... stare out the window instead of finishing my seatwork.
Do you have the same trouble paying attention at home, too?

Yeah... I guess so. My husband pretty much had to take over the bills and... reminders. I just kept misplacing the paperwork, or... missing things that needed to be done. So he handles it now. 

It's just... it's a problem everywhere. Like at work, my mistakes and all the delays... I've actually lost commissions. Had to redo jobs. The rest of the crew, they... well, they aren't very willing to rely on me for scheduling or ordering materials anymore.
When you were a child, were you often fidgety or unable to stay seated when you were expected to?
No... not really. I mean, I wasn't one of those kids bouncing off the walls or anything. I just... sat there.
